title: Understanding HPV Mitigation Content in Highly Engaged YouTube Videos: A Mixed-Method Topic Modeling and Sentiment Analysis of Videos and Related Comments Study.
abstract: As the most common sexually transmitted infection and leading cause of several cancers, the human papillomavirus (HPV) warrants careful attention in how it is portrayed and discussed on social media platforms such as YouTube. This study examines highly commented YouTube videos about HPV to analyze how different content creators frame health information and behaviors, and how audiences respond. We applied the Health Belief Model to evaluate how different creators portrayed health information, performed sentiment analysis to assess comments' emotions, and conducted topic modeling to identify key themes emerging from the comments.
